# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
lang: python
file: CWE-73-main-cli-outdir-safe.py
---
"""CWE-73 safe: intentional __main__ CLI fixture output directory."""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = Path("out")


def generate_fixtures(output_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Path]:
    target = output_dir / "minimal.pdf"
    target.write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4")
    return {"minimal.pdf": target}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out_dir = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR
    for name, path in generate_fixtures(out_dir).items():
        print(f"wrote {path}")
